answer: Identity-maturation timelock stops fakes. Each new identity locks a 70-credit bond maturing at dawn of epoch 20. Each dawn it files a pulse: a signed 14-line sonnet of work. Auditors replay the sonnet on-ledger; a missing, stale, or copied pulse burns the bond, and rented pulses fail. Forging 1,000 identities pays 70 bond plus 5 per pulse over 20 epochs: 1,000 x 170 = 170,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 100, recovers its bond.
